data.name: Galaxyz
data.detailed_description:
Blow it all up!

GALAXYZ is a chaotic sandbox space shooter where destruction is the only law. Pilot an immortal battle rig through an endless galaxy, obliterating everything in your path – asteroids, enemy ships, space stations, and everything in between. Watch it all explode into glorious pixel showers.

Customize your ship with devastating weapons and powerful upgrades. Enforce justice in the galaxy or bring chaos with your own battle squad. Die. Respawn. Get revenge. Repeat.

It's fast, it's frantic, and it's built for the thrill of destruction. Max out the phonk soundtrack volume, and become a legend of the galaxy!

What’s included:

  • High-octane retro – enjoy large pixel art graphics boosted with light effects and animations!

  • Smash into pixels – blow up anything into a dazzling shower of pixels!

  • Build your ship – combine parts to assemble your personal battle rig!

  • Choose your side – join treasure hunters, galactic police, pirates… or crash them all!

  • Lead your squad – hire mercenaries and deploy drones to dominate the battlefield!

  • Bass at full volume – feel the roar of jet engines drifting to the phonk soundtrack!

  • Game never over – respawn in the same spot upon destruction and take revenge!

  • Become the legend – unlock upgrades, grow stronger, and be unstoppable!

How to Play: Fun Mode

1. Shoot blasters, launch missiles, deploy mines

2. Destroy whatever you want

3. Collect loot (or destroy it)

4. Get destroyed and watch your pixels scatter into space

5. Reintegrate

6. Repeat

How to Play Like a Pro

1. Fly wherever you want and explore a vast galaxy

2. Beware of asteroids – they’re dangerous

3. Destroy asteroids and collect gems

4. Beware of space pirates – they want your gems

5. Destroy pirates… or become one and attack greedy traders

6. Traders may shoot back to protect their treasures – yet another reason to destroy them

7. But beware of galactic police – they don’t like criminals

8. Destroy police… or join them and protect the galaxy

9. Find a space station and spend gems on new powerful parts

10. Combine parts to design your battle rig and paint it your way

11. Destroy the space station – just for fun

12. Push your score higher and become a legendary pilot

13. Get blown up by a random bomb

14. Reintegrate

15. Repeat

Galaxyz Hacks

  • Don’t wanna mine gems yourself? Destroy treasure hunters and take their loot.

  • What? A hunter shoots back? Dodge his shots and let him hit a pirate or the police instead. Nobody likes being shot at – watch them do your job for you.

  • Need repairs but don’t wanna spend gems? Traders often carry spare parts in their holds…

  • Enemy too strong? Use mines and lure them into a trap.

  • Speaking of traps – wild drones and ancient bombs can be very useful.

data.short_description: Insane destruction-focused sandbox space shooter. Blow up whatever you want with blasters and missiles, customize and upgrade your battle rig, join factions or lead your squad. Progress, grow stronger, and become a legend of the galaxy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or equivalent with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2012 or newer) / Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) / Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2 GB VRAM / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
